doc: Layout and visibility facts without DOM nodes (LCP-014). Targets are named in HTML with data-measure-target (and, inside a data-each row, data-measure-key projected by the engine). Subscriptions are opaque ids; their updates arrive as capability facts. What a size or a visibility means stays the engine's decision.

types.name: SubscriptionId
types.doc: Opaque; issued by this page's pack and meaningless anywhere else.

types.name: Rect
types.doc: CSS pixels, relative to the viewport.

variants.name: viewport
variants.doc: The viewport's size and the document's scroll position and extent now.

variants.name: observeSize
variants.doc: Resized facts whenever the target's content box changes size.

variants.name: observeVisibility
variants.doc: Visibility facts whenever the target crosses the threshold (0 to 1) of intersection with the viewport.

variants.name: Subscribed
variants.doc: Facts for this subscription follow until it is unsubscribed or its target is removed.

variants.name: Stale
variants.doc: No such live subscription: never issued here, already ended, or from before a reload.

types.name: MeasureFact
types.doc: Subscription updates. The browser already coalesces observer callbacks to at most one per frame; the pack forwards the latest entry per subscription per callback.

variants.name: TargetRemoved
variants.doc: The target left the document; the subscription has ended and nothing more will be sent for it.
